name: Penuel
overview: Penuel was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Shashak. His mention in Scripture is brief, providing limited information about his life or role beyond his genealogical placement.
namesAndTitles: The name Penuel means 'face of God [El],' reflecting a theophoric element common in Hebrew names. This meaning is noted in 1 Chronicles 8:25, though the name was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Penuel was the son of Shashak. Beyond this explicit father-son relationship, no additional family connections are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Penuel's significance lies primarily in his genealogical mention within the tribe of Benjamin, serving to trace the lineage and heritage of this tribe. His inclusion in the biblical record emphasizes the importance of family lines in God's providential plan, even when individual details are sparse.
